item.title: US mortality rates rising compared with other countries
item.description: Research in The Milbank Quarterly shows that U.S. mortality rates have surpassed those of peer countries for decades and continue to increase.

item.title: Endomicroscopy ineffective for guiding IBS diets
item.description: Confocal laser endomicroscopy shows mucosal changes in all IBS patients and healthy volunteers before or after food exposure, with a target.

item.title: GLP-1 equity, GI obesity care, prescriptions vs lifestyle
item.description: Are guardrails needed in the GLP-1 era? Should gastroenterologists lead obesity care? What is the evidence for lifestyle-first mandates? Medscape Medic.

item.title: Drug delivery system releases nerve block over weeks
item.description: Most local anesthetics last only eight to 12 hours, or a day at most. Boston Children's Hospital researchers have formulated a method.
